candidate: Add 12 finite List controls to the isolated Serde-derive prototype; no runtime changes. Existing native/Candid lanes retained.
source: Full source/Cargo snapshots in raw.json.gz. Restored both-codec IC driver from baseline; prototype.patch records previous Wire-only driver variant. Embedded Git identity refers to main working repository via GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE; source snapshots identify measured code.
scope: Standard cohort, both profiles, separately linked Wire/Candid Wasm; two native runs per profile with eleven samples and two millisecond calibration; separate allocation/heap builds; three IC samples with 4 repetitions <=64KiB and 1 above. No subtraction. Serial warm benchmarks on unpinned Linux, not application latency. Excludes gzip from comparison.

instructions.notes: Warm operations; result destruction and loop overhead included. Loop control reported, not subtracted. Setup/reply transport excluded. Exact frames checked against native fixtures.
